lines.en: and change of air it brings, and drowning and disaster of ships and bewilderment of sailors will be. (Chapter Seven on the judgments

lines.text: غله خاصه جو و کثرت طعام و میوه و بسیاری ایمنی و فرح و ارزانی و صحت ابدان و امراض

sections.en: Judgments of the transfer of the Moon

summary.headline: Mercury and Moon Transfers
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mercury’s entry into Aquarius and Pisces, including weather, food, disease, rumors, winds, locusts, and the dangers of Mercury retrograde in Pisces, citing Sayyid Ibn Tawus’s Lata'if al-Kalam. Chapter Seven then begins the Moon’s transfer through Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, and Leo, with omens for rulers, rain, crops, markets, war, travel, and public welfare.
